missing.why: The Hebrew explicitly calls Jair בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה, son of Manasseh, while the existing descendant-of row records only broader ancestry.

note: Owner row 106558 appears unsupported: 1KI 4:13 assigns Jair's towns to Ben-geber and calls Jair son of Manasseh, without saying Manasseh descended from Ben-geber. The chapter does not establish that Ben-geber's father is the Geber named in verse 19.
